A memorable experience worth trying!
Mar 2024 • Friends
Tucked away in an alley, this quaint restaurant charms with its simple yet cozy design, offering an intimate dining atmosphere. The lighting is thoughtfully arranged, enhancing the warm ambiance. 
The staff stands out for their professionalism and friendliness, meticulously explaining each dish's ingredients. 
The menu is diverse, featuring an array of dishes including sashimi and sushi that are notably fresh, with some pieces melting delightfully in your mouth. 

However, there's room for improvement regarding the chefs' uniforms, which could be updated to reflect the high standards of cleanliness and quality expected, especially considering the price point of over 200USD per person. Additionally, the restroom facilities could benefit from better upkeep to meet higher cleanliness standards. Despite these minor critiques, dining here offers a memorable experience worth trying.

We were here for our anniversary dinner. This restaurant came out as a totally surprise for both of us. The food is amazing. All the dishes are presented in their own unique dishes. My first Omakase experience
Jan 2019
Firstly, I must say it was one of my most pricey meals, just more than 200 USD each person. :D 

Secondly, the location is not that easy to find, we had to walked into a small alley to a small door that led to the restaurant. It's a small place but high ceiling that makes guests feel it not narrow or stuffy. The design is nature friendly with the green surrounded. 

They only serve 8 guests at a time slot (there are two time slots for dinner, If I am correct, It's 5:30-7:00PM and 7:30-9:00PM). I was impressed watching the Japanese chef to use the knife skilfully and roll the sushi carefully and professionally. The way he adds ingredients to the dishes is also very attractive. He proudly presents to the guests about the food before serving. 

Of course the fish is superb fresh and I just tried some kinds of them for the first time. Because It is very fresh, I can smell the delicious odour of the fish, and slowly taste the fish in my mount until it melted. Well It's hard to explain, I feel it when I it real food, natural food. The sushi rice is special, very soft and ambrosial. I love it. 

It was my first Omakase experience, of course I enjoyed everything, the chef's cooking technique, the excellent fresh fish and food, the sake, and even the glass of drinking water, and the service. 

It's worth for a newly experience of culture and dining.
